result:
I've opened [PR #421](https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/421) closing all 26 findings under the AI Architecture / Explainability & Transparency parameter. Summary of what shipped:

- **Shared infra**: error-code catalog (`friendlyMessage`/`remediationSteps`), a generic `AiDecisionExplanation` type + UI card, `EngineResult<T>`, a new business terminology glossary.
- **Applied to real code**: CRM AI scoring now includes rejected alternatives/assumptions/confidence, report aggregations now always explain themselves, the help chatbot is now RAG-grounded in the knowledge base, high-impact-action detection got 3 new categories plus sample-audit logging, and workflow routing decisions are now logged with a rationale.
- **Honesty on scope**: PROGRESS.md documents everywhere a finding's description was stale versus current code, and explicitly calls out what was *not* done (e.g., rewriting all ~683 error-handling call sites, migrating all ~100 engine functions) as deliberate scope decisions rather than silent gaps.
- **Verification**: typecheck clean, lint clean, full test suite green (1452 pass, including 46 new assertions).

I scheduled a check-back in ~4 minutes to confirm CI passes on the PR; I'll fix anything that comes up and report back.
